title: Complete Guide: Choosing Between P4 and P10 LED Displays
author: Mr. Fixon Technical Team
excerpt: Learn the difference in viewing distance, brightness (nits), weatherproofing, and cost considerations between indoor P4 and outdoor P10 screens.
body:
When choosing an LED display screen for your commercial property or advertising site, pixel pitch (represented as 'P') is the single most critical specification...

### What Does Pixel Pitch Mean?
Pixel pitch indicates the distance in millimeters between the centers of two adjacent pixels. A P4 display has 4mm between LEDs, while a P10 display has 10mm.

### Optimum Viewing Distance
- **P4 Display**: Optimal viewing distance is 4 meters to 20 meters. Ideal for indoor spaces.
- **P10 Display**: Optimal viewing distance is 10 meters to 100+ meters. Ideal for large outdoor billboards.
